title: A two-chirality twistor correspondence for smooth Lorentzian Ricci-flat germs
description: This preprint gives a local two-chirality twistor presentation of smooth pointed, oriented and time-oriented Lorentzian Ricci-flat four-germs with spin at their physical scale. Two ordinary cohomology classes on a fixed flat hypersurface twistor CR space determine maximal vacuum data. Conversely, a physical germ determines a local comparison class of presentations. A covariant wave kernel relates the presentations across spacelike carriers. The supplement records four finite exact checks concerning the constraint inverses, exterior momentum range, wave transport and analytic comparison.
